title: Save a browser preference
summary: The persist middleware can store selected state in browser storage.

Explain the example for save a browser preference

blocks.text: The persist middleware can store selected state in browser storage. It restores that state on a later visit in the same browser.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.

blocks.text: The theme choice can survive a reload where localStorage is available.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Browser storage may be cleared or blocked. Never store passwords or promise that this syncs across devices.
